phases.title: Immediate Priority
phases.description: No or minimal requirements. Complete these first to build quest points, unlock core skills, and get early XP boosts that skip painful low-level training.

quests.name: Learning the Ropes
quests.why: Tutorial quest that grants starter XP and introduces game mechanics.

quests.name: Cook's Assistant
quests.why: Fast 1-minute quest; prerequisite for Recipe for Disaster.

quests.name: Sheep Shearer
quests.why: Quick quest point with free Crafting XP; grab extra wool for Prince Ali Rescue.

quests.name: Misthalin Mystery
quests.why: Easy Crafting XP boost in early game when training options are limited.

quests.name: The Restless Ghost
quests.why: Jumps Prayer to 9 instantly; prerequisite for Animal Magnetism and Fairytale II.

quests.name: X Marks the Spot
quests.why: Free antique lamp - use on Slayer to skip early levels where tasks are painful.

quests.name: Witch's Potion
quests.why: Instant Magic boost; very quick quest in Rimmington.

quests.name: Imp Catcher
quests.why: Good early Magic XP and a useful starting amulet for ironmen.

quests.name: Romeo & Juliet
quests.why: Best quest-point-per-minute ratio in the game - 5 QP for a short dialogue quest.

quests.name: Gertrude's Cat
quests.why: Unlocks cat raising which is essential for death rune trading and spicy stews.
quests.key_rewards: 1,525 Cooking XP, chocolate cake, stew, kitten

quests.name: Rune Mysteries
quests.why: Unlocks ability to use XP lamps/books on Runecraft; prerequisite for many quests.

quests.name: Client of Kourend
quests.why: Two free antique lamps plus unlocks all Kourend quest lines and favour.

quests.name: Children of the Sun
quests.why: Unlocks access to Varlamore, a major content region.

quests.name: Pandemonium
quests.why: Unlocks the Sailing skill entirely - must be done to access sailing content.

quests.name: Doric's Quest
quests.why: Jumps Mining to 10 instantly; very fast quest.

quests.name: Goblin Diplomacy
quests.why: 5 quest points for a trivial quest; prerequisite for RFD Goblin Generals.

quests.name: Ernest the Chicken
quests.why: 4 quick quest points; prerequisite for Animal Magnetism.

quests.name: Prince Ali Rescue
quests.why: Free passage through Al Kharid gate saves time; prerequisite for Beneath Cursed Sands.
quests.key_rewards: 700 coins, free Al Kharid gate passage

quests.name: Shield of Arrav
quests.why: Required for Heroes' Quest which gates Barrows gloves and Dragon Slayer II.

quests.name: Pirate's Treasure
quests.why: Quick quest points; no requirements at all.

quests.name: Black Knights' Fortress
quests.why: Good quest points for minimal effort; needed for Recruitment Drive.

quests.name: The Knight's Sword
quests.why: Jumps Smithing from 1 to 29 instantly - the best early Smithing shortcut.

quests.name: Druidic Ritual
quests.why: Unlocks the Herblore skill entirely; must be done before any herb training.

quests.name: Witch's House
quests.why: Massive HP XP skip with zero requirements; boosts survivability early.

quests.name: Daddy's Home (miniquest)
quests.why: Gives a player-owned house and Construction levels for free.
quests.key_rewards: Construction XP (to level 8), POH in Rimmington

quests.name: Natural History Quiz (miniquest)
quests.why: Free Slayer and Hunter XP - use the Varrock Museum quiz displays.

phases.title: Early Game
phases.description: Low requirements but huge payoffs. These quests unlock key transportation, give massive combat XP, and open essential content areas.

quests.name: Waterfall Quest
quests.why: Jumps Attack and Strength to 30 with zero requirements - the single best early quest.

quests.name: Tree Gnome Village
quests.why: Unlocks spirit tree network for free teleportation across the map.

quests.name: The Grand Tree
quests.why: Unlocks gnome glider system and is prerequisite for Monkey Madness I.
quests.key_rewards: 18,400 Attack XP, 7,900 Agility XP, 2,150 Magic XP

quests.name: Fight Arena
quests.why: Large Attack XP dump with no requirements; pushes melee levels fast.

quests.name: Vampyre Slayer
quests.why: Free Attack XP and 3 quest points with minimal effort.

quests.name: Death Plateau
quests.why: Prerequisite for Troll Stronghold which unlocks God Wars Dungeon access.

quests.name: Holy Grail
quests.why: Jumps Defence to 28+ and Prayer to 30+ instantly; one of the best early XP quests.

quests.name: Merlin's Crystal
quests.why: 6 quest points and unlocks the Camelot quest line leading to King's Ransom/Piety.

quests.name: Plague City
quests.why: Unlocks Ardougne Teleport spell - essential for travel; starts the elf quest series.

quests.name: Biohazard
quests.why: Unlocks combat training area and is required for Underground Pass/elf series.

quests.name: Hazeel Cult
quests.why: Quick Thieving XP and quest point in Ardougne area.

quests.name: Monk's Friend
quests.why: Easy Woodcutting XP with no requirements.

quests.name: Sheep Herder
quests.why: 4 quest points and required for Mourning's End Part I / elf series.

quests.name: Priest in Peril
quests.why: Unlocks access to Morytania - barrows, slayer tower, and the entire Myreque series.

quests.name: Recruitment Drive
quests.why: Prerequisite for The Slug Menace which unlocks proselyte armour for Prayer training.
quests.key_rewards: 1,000 Prayer XP, 1,000 Herblore XP, 1,000 Agility XP

quests.name: The Tourist Trap
quests.why: Choose Agility for both lamps to skip painful early levels; unlocks desert area.
quests.key_rewards: 4,650 XP in 2 skills of choice (choose Agility twice)

quests.name: Clock Tower
quests.why: Free quest point near Ardougne with no requirements.

quests.name: Murder Mystery
quests.why: 3 quest points; prerequisite for King's Ransom which unlocks Piety prayer.

quests.name: Dwarf Cannon
quests.why: Unlocks the dwarf multicannon - essential for fast Slayer on an ironman.

quests.name: Fishing Contest
quests.why: Prerequisite for RFD Mountain Dwarf subquest; gives access to Hemenster.

quests.name: Jungle Potion
quests.why: Prerequisite for Shilo Village (gem mine), Tai Bwo Wannai Trio, and Zogre Flesh Eaters.

quests.name: The Corsair Curse
quests.why: Easy 2 quest points; unlocks Corsair Cove with free-to-play resources.

quests.name: Below Ice Mountain
quests.why: Quick quest point that unlocks the Ruins of Camdozaal area.
quests.key_rewards: 2,000 coins, access to the Ruins of Camdozaal

quests.name: The Ides of Milk
quests.why: Free lamp - use on Prayer to boost towards protection prayers faster.

quests.name: Sleeping Giants
quests.why: Unlocks Giants' Foundry - the best ironman Smithing training method.

quests.name: Making History
quests.why: 3 QP plus a lamp; hold the Kudos lamp for later when you need it most.
quests.quest_prereqs: Priest in Peril, The Restless Ghost
quests.key_rewards: 1,000 Crafting XP, 1,000 Prayer XP, antique lamp

quests.name: Enter the Abyss (miniquest)
quests.why: Unlocks Abyss runecrafting - the primary method for crafting nature runes and beyond.

quests.name: Demon Slayer
quests.why: 3 quest points; Silverlight is needed for Shadow of the Storm.

quests.name: A Ruff Situation
quests.why: Quick Novice quest point at the dog shelter south-west of Edgeville Monastery; needs only a needle, thread, any fur and some grain.
quests.key_rewards: 1,000 Crafting XP, access to puppies that grow into pet dogs

phases.title: Mid Game
phases.description: Moderate requirements (30-50 in skills). These quests unlock fairy rings, ancient magicks, key gear slots, slayer content, and important training methods.

quests.name: Fairytale I - Growing Pains
quests.why: Immediately start Fairytale II after to unlock fairy rings without the stat requirements.
quests.key_rewards: 2,000 Attack XP, 1,000 Magic XP, 3,500 Farming XP

quests.name: Lost City
quests.why: Unlocks Zanaris (cosmic rune crafting) and is prerequisite for fairy rings and dragon weapons.

quests.name: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen
quests.why: START this quest to unlock fairy rings - the best teleport network - without finishing it.

quests.name: Nature Spirit
quests.why: Unlocks silver sickle (blessed) for Mort Myre fungi; prerequisite for Fairytale I.
quests.quest_prereqs: Priest in Peril, The Restless Ghost
quests.key_rewards: 2,000 Defence XP, 3,000 Crafting XP, 2,000 Hitpoints XP

quests.name: Observatory Quest
quests.why: Gives random Attack/Strength/Defence/HP XP; useful filler for quest points.
quests.key_rewards: 2,250 Crafting XP, random combat XP reward

quests.name: The Lost Tribe
quests.why: Opens Dorgeshuun area and is prerequisite for Death to the Dorgeshuun and RFD.

quests.name: Death to the Dorgeshuun
quests.why: Prerequisite for Another Slice of H.A.M. which unlocks Dorgesh-Kaan train.

quests.name: Another Slice of H.A.M.
quests.why: Unlocks Dorgesh-Kaan to Keldagrim train system for convenient travel.
quests.quest_prereqs: Death to the Dorgeshuun, The Dig Site, The Giant Dwarf

quests.name: Ghosts Ahoy
quests.why: Ectophial is an infinite free teleport to Morytania - essential for barrows trips.
quests.quest_prereqs: Priest in Peril, The Restless Ghost

quests.name: Dragon Slayer I
quests.why: Unlocks rune platebody, dragon Slayer tasks, and anti-dragon shield; major milestone.

quests.name: Scorpion Catcher
quests.why: Good Strength XP; requires visiting several locations but no hard fights.

quests.name: Tribal Totem
quests.why: Quick quest point with a small Thieving XP reward.

quests.name: The Dig Site
quests.why: Large Mining XP and prerequisite for Desert Treasure I and Bone Voyage.

quests.name: Shadow of the Storm
quests.why: 10K combat XP lamp - choose Ranged to skip painful low levels on an ironman.
quests.key_rewards: 10,000 XP in combat skill of choice (use on Ranged)

quests.name: Horror from the Deep
quests.why: Unlocks god books - free prayer bonus for the shield slot; essential early gear.
quests.key_rewards: 4,662 Strength XP, 4,662 Ranged XP, 4,662 Magic XP, god book

quests.name: Animal Magnetism
quests.why: Unlocks Ava's attractor (accumulator at 50 Ranged) - the ammo-saving Ranged cape every iron uses until the assembler (Dragon Slayer II) and Dizana's quiver.
quests.quest_prereqs: Ernest the Chicken, Priest in Peril, The Restless Ghost

quests.name: Icthlarin's Little Helper
quests.why: Prerequisite for Contact! and Beneath Cursed Sands (Tombs of Amascut).
quests.key_rewards: 4,500 Thieving XP, 4,000 Agility XP, 4,000 Woodcutting XP

quests.name: The Golem
quests.why: Prerequisite for Shadow of the Storm and Desert Treasure I.

quests.name: Elemental Workshop I
quests.why: Good Crafting/Smithing XP; prerequisite for Elemental Workshop II.

quests.name: Elemental Workshop II
quests.why: Solid Smithing and Crafting XP for moderate requirements.

quests.name: A Soul's Bane
quests.why: Quick quest point east of Varrock; minor XP gains.

quests.name: Shilo Village
quests.why: Unlocks gem rocks for Crafting training and is prerequisite for multiple quest chains.

quests.name: Big Chompy Bird Hunting
quests.why: Prerequisite for RFD Skrach Uglogwee and Zogre Flesh Eaters.
quests.key_rewards: 262 Fletching XP, 1,470 Cooking XP, 735 Ranged XP

quests.name: Zogre Flesh Eaters
quests.why: Unlocks brutal arrows and Jiggig area for clue scrolls.
quests.quest_prereqs: Big Chompy Bird Hunting, Jungle Potion
quests.key_rewards: 2,000 Ranged XP, 2,000 Fletching XP, 2,000 Herblore XP

quests.name: Mountain Daughter
quests.why: Good Prayer XP and prerequisite for The Fremennik Exiles.

quests.name: Sea Slug
quests.why: Big Fishing XP jump and prerequisite for The Slug Menace (proselyte armour).

quests.name: The Slug Menace
quests.why: Unlocks proselyte armour - the best Prayer bonus armour set for Slayer.

quests.name: Wanted!
quests.why: Prerequisite for The Slug Menace; gives decent Slayer XP.

quests.name: Tower of Life
quests.why: Unlocks Creature Creation for efficient unicorn horn and red spider egg farming.
quests.key_rewards: 500 Crafting XP, 1,000 Construction XP, 500 Thieving XP

quests.name: Creature of Fenkenstrain
quests.why: Ring of charos for discounts; prerequisite for A Tail of Two Cats.
quests.quest_prereqs: Priest in Peril, The Restless Ghost

quests.name: Troll Stronghold
quests.why: Unlocks God Wars Dungeon access and law rune crafting on Entrana.

quests.name: Troll Romance
quests.why: Good Agility XP and prerequisite for some quests down the line.

quests.name: Eadgar's Ruse
quests.why: Largest Herblore XP reward from any single quest; prerequisite for Dream Mentor.

quests.name: The Feud
quests.why: Massive Thieving XP and unlocks blackjacking - the best Thieving training method.

quests.name: The Fremennik Trials
quests.why: Unlocks Fremennik helms, access to Neitiznot/Jatizso, and starts the Fremennik series.

quests.name: The Fremennik Isles
quests.why: Helm of Neitiznot - best-in-slot helmet for a huge portion of the mid-game.

quests.name: In Search of the Myreque
quests.why: Opens the Myreque quest chain leading to Morytania content and barrows.

quests.name: In Aid of the Myreque
quests.why: Opens Burgh de Rott bank near barrows; prerequisite for Darkness of Hallowvale.

quests.name: Shades of Mort'ton
quests.why: 3 QP and unlocks shade burning for gold keys and prayer XP.

quests.name: What Lies Below
quests.why: Good Runecraft XP and unlocks Chaos Altar teleport.

quests.name: The Giant Dwarf
quests.why: Access to Keldagrim and blast furnace - the best Smithing training method for ironmen.

quests.name: Forgettable Tale of a Drunken Dwarf
quests.why: Required for Mourning's End Part I and the elf quest chain.

quests.name: Between a Rock...
quests.why: Solid XP across three skills and prerequisite for some diaries.
quests.key_rewards: 5,000 Defence XP, 5,000 Mining XP, 5,000 Smithing XP

quests.name: Contact!
quests.why: Unlocks Sophanem bank and Keris dagger; prerequisite for Beneath Cursed Sands.
quests.quest_prereqs: Prince Ali Rescue, Icthlarin's Little Helper

quests.name: The Eyes of Glouphrie
quests.why: Unlocks crystal saw (+3 Construction boost) - essential for POH building.

quests.name: Temple of Ikov
quests.why: Good Ranged/Fletching XP; prerequisite for Desert Treasure I.

quests.name: Watchtower
quests.why: Unlocks Watchtower Teleport and is prerequisite for Monkey Madness II.

quests.name: Rag and Bone Man I
quests.why: Start collecting bones early; Rag and Bone Man II gives 5,000 Prayer XP.

quests.name: Eagles' Peak
quests.why: Unlocks box trapping - key Hunter training method for chinchompas.

quests.name: Enlightened Journey
quests.why: Unlocks balloon transport system for fast travel to Crafting Guild and elsewhere.

quests.name: Tears of Guthix
quests.why: Weekly free XP in your lowest skill - do this ASAP and never miss a week. Also required for While Guthix Sleeps.
quests.key_rewards: 1,000 Crafting XP, weekly free XP in lowest skill

quests.name: Bone Voyage
quests.why: Unlocks Fossil Island for birdhouse runs (best passive Hunter XP), ammonite crabs, and herbiboar.

quests.name: The Queen of Thieves
quests.why: Prerequisite for A Kingdom Divided; quick Kourend quest.

quests.name: The Depths of Despair
quests.why: Prerequisite for A Kingdom Divided; quick Kourend quest.
quests.key_rewards: 1,500 Agility XP, 4,000 coins, Kharedst's memoirs page

quests.name: The Ascent of Arceuus
quests.why: Prerequisite for A Kingdom Divided; quick Kourend quest.

quests.name: Tale of the Righteous
quests.why: Prerequisite for A Kingdom Divided; short Kourend quest.

quests.name: The Forsaken Tower
quests.why: Prerequisite for A Kingdom Divided; very short quest.

quests.name: A Porcine of Interest
quests.why: Quick Slayer XP and unlocks sourhog Slayer task.

quests.name: Ratcatchers
quests.why: Unlocks lazy and wily cats for passive money-making via death rune trading.

quests.name: Temple of the Eye
quests.why: Unlocks Guardians of the Rift - the best Runecraft training minigame.
quests.key_rewards: Runecraft XP, access to Guardians of the Rift

quests.name: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute
quests.why: Quick quest point with small Woodcutting XP reward.

quests.name: Getting Ahead
quests.why: Good Construction XP; needed for some diaries.

quests.name: Cold War
quests.why: Penguin spy mechanics; moderate XP across several skills.
quests.key_rewards: 2,000 Crafting XP, 5,000 Agility XP, 1,500 Construction XP

quests.name: The Hand in the Sand
quests.why: Good Crafting XP and unlocks daily sand delivery (84 buckets/day) for ironman glass making.

quests.name: Enakhra's Lament
quests.why: Good multi-skill XP; prerequisite for Desert Treasure II.

quests.name: One Small Favour
quests.why: Two antique lamps and prerequisite for Swan Song; annoying but worth it.

quests.name: Cabin Fever
quests.why: Unlocks Mos Le'Harmless and half-price charter ship fares.
quests.key_rewards: 7,000 Agility XP, 7,000 Crafting XP, 7,000 Smithing XP

quests.name: Rum Deal
quests.why: Prerequisite for Cabin Fever and The Great Brain Robbery.
quests.quest_prereqs: Zogre Flesh Eaters, Priest in Peril
quests.key_rewards: 7,000 Prayer XP, 7,000 Fishing XP, 7,000 Farming XP

quests.name: Tai Bwo Wannai Trio
quests.why: Unlocks karambwan fishing - great food source for ironmen and cooking training.

quests.name: Family Crest
quests.why: Goldsmith gauntlets for blast furnace gold - the best Smithing XP method.

quests.name: Recipe for Disaster/Another Cook's Quest
quests.why: Starts the RFD quest chain leading to Barrows gloves.

quests.name: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf
quests.why: Easy RFD subquest with free Slayer XP.

quests.name: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin Generals
quests.why: Easy RFD subquest; good multi-skill XP.
quests.key_rewards: 1,000 Cooking XP, 1,000 Crafting XP, 1,000 Farming XP

quests.name: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Pirate Pete
quests.why: Moderate RFD subquest with multi-skill XP.

quests.name: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide
quests.why: Requires many quest prereqs but gives good Cooking and Magic XP.

quests.name: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Evil Dave
quests.why: Unlocks spicy stew boosting - essential ironman mechanic for +5 skill boosts.

quests.name: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Skrach Uglogwee
quests.why: Multi-skill XP RFD subquest; needed for Barrows gloves.

quests.name: Prying Times
quests.why: Unlocks sealed crate opening - important sailing progression mechanic.

quests.name: Current Affairs
quests.why: Unlocks current ducks for faster sailing navigation.

quests.name: Crab Quest
quests.why: Short Intermediate quest on Dognose Island, north-west of the Great Conch - 10K Sailing XP for one quick quest point.
quests.quest_prereqs: None (Pandemonium is needed to train Sailing)
quests.key_rewards: 10,000 Sailing XP, 3,000 Fishing XP, shell collection

phases.title: Late-Mid Game
phases.description: Higher requirements (50-70 in skills). Major content gates including ancient magicks, lunar spells, dragon scimitar, Barrows gloves, and key boss access.

quests.name: Desert Treasure I
quests.why: Unlocks Ancient Magicks spellbook - ice barrage is essential for PvM and Slayer.

quests.name: Monkey Madness I
quests.why: Unlocks dragon scimitar - best melee weapon until 60 Attack; massive combat XP.
quests.quest_prereqs: The Grand Tree, Tree Gnome Village

quests.name: Underground Pass
quests.why: Iban's staff is the best Magic weapon for mid-game; opens path to elf lands.
quests.key_rewards: 3,000 Attack XP, 3,000 Agility XP, Iban's staff

quests.name: Regicide
quests.why: Unlocks Tirannwn region and Zulrah access; required for the elf quest chain.

quests.name: Roving Elves
quests.why: Crystal equipment access; prerequisite for Mourning's End and Song of the Elves.

quests.name: Mourning's End Part I
quests.why: Prerequisite for Mourning's End Part II and Song of the Elves.
quests.quest_prereqs: Roving Elves, Big Chompy Bird Hunting, Sheep Herder

quests.name: Mourning's End Part II
quests.why: Unlocks Death Altar for death rune crafting and dark beasts; prerequisite for Song of the Elves.

quests.name: Lunar Diplomacy
quests.why: Unlocks Lunar spellbook - vengeance, NPC Contact, superglass make are essential for ironmen.
quests.key_rewards: 5,000 Magic XP, 5,000 Runecraft XP, 50 astral runes

quests.name: Dream Mentor
quests.why: Unlocks 7 Lunar spells including Humidify, Plank Make, and Spellbook Swap.

quests.name: King's Ransom
quests.why: Unlocks Piety and Chivalry prayers (after Knight Waves) - the best melee prayers.
quests.key_rewards: 33,000 Defence XP, 5,000 Magic XP, antique lamp

quests.name: Knight Waves Training Ground (miniquest)
quests.why: This is the step that actually unlocks Piety (70 Prayer, 70 Defence) and Chivalry (60 Prayer, 65 Defence), plus 80K melee XP. Safe death for Hardcore Ironmen, but not for Hardcore Group Ironmen.
quests.skill_reqs: None (melee only: no Prayer, Ranged or Magic inside)

quests.name: Darkness of Hallowvale
quests.why: Opens Meiyerditch; prerequisite for A Taste of Hope (access to Hallowed Sepulchre).

quests.name: A Taste of Hope
quests.why: Unlocks Drakan's medallion teleports and access to ver sinhaza; prerequisite for Sins of the Father.

quests.name: Throne of Miscellania
quests.why: Unlocks Managing Miscellania - a passive resource generator that every ironman needs.

quests.name: Royal Trouble
quests.why: Expands Miscellania to Etceteria - doubles your passive resource gathering.

quests.name: Heroes' Quest
quests.why: Unlocks Heroes' Guild (dragon battleaxe/mace); prerequisite for Legends' Quest and DSII.

quests.name: Legends' Quest
quests.why: Unlocks Legends' Guild and dragon sq shield; prerequisite for Dragon Slayer II.

quests.name: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Sir Amik Varze
quests.why: One of the hardest RFD subquests; requires extensive quest completion.
quests.quest_prereqs: Heroes' Quest, Dragon Slayer I, many others

quests.name: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing King Awowogei
quests.why: Requires Monkey Madness I completion; needed for Barrows gloves.

quests.name: Recipe for Disaster/Defeating the Culinaromancer
quests.why: Barrows gloves - the single most important gear unlock in the entire game for ironmen.
quests.skill_reqs: 175 Quest Points, all RFD subquests complete
quests.quest_prereqs: All 8 RFD subquests, Desert Treasure I, Horror from the Deep

quests.name: Garden of Tranquillity
quests.why: Prerequisite for Swan Song; moderate Farming XP.

quests.name: A Tail of Two Cats
quests.why: Two antique lamps; prerequisite for Dragon Slayer II.

quests.name: Devious Minds
quests.why: Good multi-skill XP for mid-level requirements.
quests.quest_prereqs: Wanted!, Troll Stronghold, Doric's Quest, Enter the Abyss
quests.key_rewards: 5,000 Fletching XP, 5,000 Runecraft XP, 6,500 Smithing XP

quests.name: My Arm's Big Adventure
quests.why: Unlocks disease-free herb patch on Trollheim - never loses crops, essential for ironman Herblore.
quests.quest_prereqs: Eadgar's Ruse, The Feud, Jungle Potion

quests.name: Swan Song
quests.why: Unlocks monkfish fishing - excellent mid-level food source for ironmen.
quests.quest_prereqs: One Small Favour, Garden of Tranquillity

quests.name: The Great Brain Robbery
quests.why: Good Prayer XP and unlocks barrelchest anchor weapon.
quests.key_rewards: 3,000 Crafting XP, 6,000 Prayer XP, 2,000 Construction XP

quests.name: Olaf's Quest
quests.why: Solid Defence XP for moderate requirements.

quests.name: Grim Tales
quests.why: Massive XP dump across six skills; great for ironman skill progression.

quests.name: The Path of Glouphrie
quests.why: Good multi-skill XP; continues the gnome storyline and is required for While Guthix Sleeps.
quests.quest_prereqs: The Eyes of Glouphrie, Waterfall Quest

quests.name: Land of the Goblins
quests.why: Multi-skill XP; part of the Dorgeshuun quest series.

quests.name: Spirits of the Elid
quests.why: Good Prayer XP and access to desert areas.
quests.key_rewards: 8,000 Prayer XP, 1,000 Magic XP, 1,000 Thieving XP

quests.name: The Garden of Death
quests.why: Good Farming XP; prerequisite for Desert Treasure II.

quests.name: Twilight's Promise
quests.why: Unlocks Varlamore quest series and access to new content areas.

quests.name: At First Light
quests.why: Varlamore content quest; moderate skill requirements.
quests.quest_prereqs: Children of the Sun, Eagles' Peak
quests.key_rewards: 4,500 Hunter XP, 500 Herblore XP, 800 Construction XP

quests.name: Death on the Isle
quests.why: Varlamore quest with good multi-skill XP rewards.
quests.key_rewards: 10,000 Thieving XP, 7,500 Agility XP, 5,000 Crafting XP

quests.name: The Heart of Darkness
quests.why: Varlamore quest; prerequisite for The Final Dawn.
quests.quest_prereqs: Children of the Sun, Twilight's Promise

quests.name: Meat and Greet
quests.why: Cooking XP in Varlamore; quick quest.

quests.name: Ethically Acquired Antiquities
quests.why: Quick Thieving XP and coins from a short Varlamore quest.
quests.quest_prereqs: Children of the Sun, Shield of Arrav

quests.name: Shadows of Custodia
quests.why: Multi-skill XP in Varlamore; moderate requirements.

quests.name: Scrambled!
quests.why: Cooking and Construction XP; Varlamore quest.
quests.key_rewards: 5,000 Cooking XP, 5,000 Construction XP, 5,000 Smithing XP

quests.name: Troubled Tortugans
quests.why: Unlocks the Great Conch hub and starts the Tortugan series leading to The Red Reef.

quests.name: The Red Reef
quests.why: Capstone of the Tortugan series - unlocks Red Rock and the Sacred Grove for Sailing progression.

quests.name: Fallen From Grace
quests.why: Wyrmscraig quest that unlocks Golem Crafting - a 60+ Crafting method with no Magic or Lunar Diplomacy requirement - plus the repeatable Mad Angel boss and Slayer ring teleports to the island.

quests.name: Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl (miniquest)
quests.why: The Barbarian Outpost Agility Course it unlocks is needed during Horror from the Deep (god books) and Scorpion Catcher.

quests.name: Skippy and the Mogres (miniquest)
quests.why: Mogres drop flippers and mudskipper hats for clue scroll items.
quests.skill_reqs: 20 Cooking (32 Slayer to kill mogres after)

quests.name: Barbarian Training (miniquest)
quests.why: Unlocks barbarian fishing (passive Agility/Strength XP), pyre ships, and hasta creation.

quests.name: Mage Arena I (miniquest)
quests.why: God cape and staff are best-in-slot magic cape/weapon until much later upgrades.

phases.title: Endgame
phases.description: High requirements (65-75+ in skills). Grandmaster quests that unlock the most powerful content: Prifddinas, Vorkath, Demonic Gorillas, Tombs of Amascut, DT2 bosses, and The Fractured Archive raid.

quests.name: Song of the Elves
quests.why: Unlocks Prifddinas (elf city) - crystal equipment, Gauntlet, Zalcano, and elite skilling methods.
quests.quest_prereqs: Mourning's End Part II, Making History

quests.name: Dragon Slayer II
quests.why: Unlocks Vorkath - one of the best consistent money-makers and supply gatherers for ironmen.

quests.name: Monkey Madness II
quests.why: Unlocks demonic gorillas (zenyte jewelry) and heavy ballista; massive XP rewards.

quests.name: Sins of the Father
quests.why: Unlocks Darkmeyer and Hallowed Sepulchre - best Agility training and ring of endurance.
quests.quest_prereqs: A Taste of Hope, Vampyre Slayer

quests.name: A Night at the Theatre
quests.why: Unlocks Theatre of Blood in quest mode; 80K total combat XP from lamps.

quests.name: A Kingdom Divided
quests.why: Unlocks the Arceuus spellbook with 24 new spells including thralls for PvM.
quests.key_rewards: 2x 10,000 XP lamps (any skill 40+), Book of the Dead

quests.name: Beneath Cursed Sands
quests.why: Unlocks Tombs of Amascut raid - endgame PvM for fang, shadow, and ward.
quests.key_rewards: 50,000 Agility XP, keris partisan, circlet of water

quests.name: The Fremennik Exiles
quests.why: Unlocks Basilisk Knights as a Slayer task - drops the jaw (best-in-slot melee helmet).

quests.name: Making Friends with My Arm
quests.why: Unlocks second disease-free herb patch (Weiss) and salt mine; fire of nourishment.
quests.quest_prereqs: My Arm's Big Adventure, Swan Song, Cold War

quests.name: Secrets of the North
quests.why: Prerequisite for Desert Treasure II; good skill XP rewards.
quests.key_rewards: 60,000 Agility XP, 50,000 Thieving XP, 40,000 Hunter XP

quests.name: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire
quests.why: Unlocks Vardorvis, Leviathan, Duke Sucellus, and Whisperer - top-tier drops including Virtus robes.

quests.name: Perilous Moons
quests.why: Unlocks Moons of Peril boss encounter in Varlamore.
quests.quest_prereqs: Twilight's Promise, Children of the Sun

quests.name: Defender of Varrock
quests.why: Part of the Mahjarrat series; prerequisite for The Curse of Arrav and While Guthix Sleeps.

quests.name: The Curse of Arrav
quests.why: 120K total XP across three skills; continues the Mahjarrat storyline.
quests.key_rewards: 40,000 Mining XP, 40,000 Thieving XP, 40,000 Agility XP

quests.name: While Guthix Sleeps
quests.why: Required to enter The Fractured Archive, the fourth raid (released 20 Oct 2026). Also unlocks Tormented Demons, and Duradel's notes let you craft the Emberlight, scorching bow and purging staff from their drops. 280K skilling XP on top.

quests.name: The Fractured Archive (miniquest)
quests.why: Starts the first time you try to enter the raid lobby beside the Ancient Guthixian Temple. Deaths inside the raid are NOT safe for Hardcore Ironmen.

quests.name: The Final Dawn
quests.why: Unlocks Doom of Mokhaiotl boss and Arkan blade; endgame Varlamore content.
quests.quest_prereqs: The Heart of Darkness, Perilous Moons

quests.name: The Blood Moon Rises
quests.why: Grandmaster finale of the Myreque series - unlocks Vampyrium and the Maggot King boss.
quests.quest_prereqs: Sins of the Father, A Night at the Theatre

quests.name: Mage Arena II (miniquest)
quests.why: Imbued god cape is the best-in-slot Magic cape for PvM until infernal/max cape.

quests.name: His Faithful Servants (miniquest)
quests.why: Large Prayer XP reward; prerequisite for Desert Treasure II.

quests.name: Into the Tombs (miniquest)
quests.why: Your first full Tombs of Amascut run (95+ combat recommended); the 50K combat XP lamp makes it worth doing as soon as you can clear the raid.

quests.name: Lair of Tarn Razorlor (miniquest)
quests.why: Enchant salve amulet for 20% accuracy/damage vs undead - essential for Vorkath.

quests.name: Haunted Mine
quests.why: Salve amulet gives 15% accuracy/damage vs undead; Lair of Tarn upgrades it further.

phases.title: Completionist & Optional
phases.description: Quests that are nice to have for quest points, diary requirements, niche unlocks, or XP dumps. Not critical for progression but round out the account.

quests.name: Rag and Bone Man II
quests.why: Good Prayer XP and fills Kudos; start bone collection early to save time.
quests.skill_reqs: 40 Slayer, 20 Defence (to wield a mirror shield)
quests.quest_prereqs: Rag and Bone Man I, Skippy and the Mogres

quests.name: Curse of the Empty Lord (miniquest)
quests.why: Free 10K XP lamp, and the ghostly robes are needed for The General's Shadow, which gates Secrets of the North.
quests.quest_prereqs: Desert Treasure I (started), The Restless Ghost (started)

quests.name: The Enchanted Key (miniquest)
quests.why: Free supplies (no XP) from digging at locations around the map; the essence and law runes are handy for an early ironman.

quests.name: The General's Shadow (miniquest)
quests.why: Prerequisite for Secrets of the North; part of the Mahjarrat story.
quests.quest_prereqs: Curse of the Empty Lord, Fight Arena

quests.name: Bear Your Soul (miniquest)
quests.why: Soul bearer auto-sends ensouled heads to bank - convenient for Prayer training.

quests.name: Family Pest (miniquest)
quests.why: Allows swapping gauntlet enchantment between goldsmith, chaos, and cooking gauntlets.

quests.name: Hopespear's Will (miniquest)
quests.why: Massive Prayer XP reward from a miniquest; excellent if you've done Land of the Goblins.

quests.name: Vale Totems (miniquest)
quests.why: Unlocks the Vale Totems minigame in Auburn Valley - Fletching XP plus offerings and research points to spend at the Vale Research Exchange.

quests.name: In Search of Knowledge (miniquest)
quests.why: Free antique lamp; found inside the Forthos Dungeon.

quests.name: The Frozen Door (miniquest)
quests.why: Unlocks the Ancient Prison where Nex is fought - endgame God Wars content.
